items: ENSO El Niño shifts Walker circulation east → subsidence over India, suppressed monsoon; La Niña generally strengthens it. Correlation has weakened since the 1980s.
IOD Indian Ocean Dipole. Positive=warmwest, cooleast→enhancedconvection near India; can offset El Niño (1997, 2019).
MJO Madden–Julian Oscillation — 30–60 day eastward convective pulse; governs active and break monsoon spells.
Clausius–Clapeyron 7% more atmospheric moisture per °C of warming — why the same circulation now delivers heavier rain.
Marine heatwave ≥5 consecutive days above the local 90th-percentile SST.

Air masses Classified by moisture (m/c) and temperature (A/P/T/E). Cold air over warm surface → unstable, cumuliform, showers; warm air over coldsurface→stable,stratiform,fog. Frontsformwherecontrastingmasses meet.

Krishna cascades. Sundarbans: Lohachara, Ghoramara. Coastal squeeze.

items: Aristotle Virtue by habituation; the mean between excess and deficiency; phronesis, practical wisdom as judgment of particulars. Use for moral courage, discretion, and why training cannot produce character.
Kant The categorical imperative; universalisability; the formula of humanity
— never treat a person merely as a means. Use for consent, data, workers and any efficiency purchased at someone’s expense.
Bentham&Mill Greatesthappiness; Mill’sharmprinciple—dislikeisnotinjury — and the publicity principle. Use for aggregation, public order, siting and paternalism.

Rawls Original position, veil of ignorance, difference principle, lexical priority of liberty; Law of Peoples on duties of assistance. Use for displacement, targeting, reservation and foreign funding.
Nozick Entitlementtheory—adistributionisjustifitarosejustly. Thehonest counter to Rawls.

Amartya Sen Capabilityratherthanresources;entitlementfailure—deprivationfromcollapseofaccess,notabsenceofsupply; comparativeratherthan transcendental justice. Use for exclusion, relief and the critique of Rawls.

Max Weber Ethic of responsibility against ethic of conviction; the official’s honour in executing an order as if it were his own conviction; legal-rational authority. Use for decisions under uncertainty and for neutrality.
Adam Smith Theimpartialspectator—theinternalisedobserverwhosejudgment is neither one’s own interest nor the crowd’s. Use for objectivity with empathy.
Lon Fuller / H.L.A. Hart The inner morality of law — eight conditions of legality — against the separation of law and morals. Use for the rule of law and conscience question.
Martin Luther King Jr Letter from Birmingham Jail on the unjust law that degrades human personality; Stride Toward Freedom on law restraining the heartless.
Kohlberg Pre-conventional, conventional, post-conventional moral development. Use for value formation, and to distinguish a code of conduct from a code of ethics.
Gordon Allport The Nature of Prejudice (1954); the contact hypothesis — equal-status, cooperative, sanctioned contact reduces prejudice.
Festinger Cognitive dissonance — behaviour change can precede attitude change; also the engine of rationalisation in ethical fading.
Bandura Social learning — values acquired by modelling and vicarious reinforcement rather than instruction.

Milgram · Asch · Zimbardo Obedience to authority · conformity to a visibly wrong majority · situational production of cruelty. The three experiments that explain administrative complicity without invoking individual vice.
Hirschman Exit, voice and loyalty — voice before exit; and the citizen who cannotexitneedsaneffectivevoice. Useforwhistleblowingandforcitizen’s charters.
Klitgaard Corruption = monopoly + discretion – accountability. Converts exhortation into a design brief.
Bazerman & Tenbrunsel Ethical fading and bounded ethicality; with
Vaughan’s normalisation of deviance, the pair for the slow slide.
James Reason Just culture and the substitution test — would a similarly trained officer plausibly have done the same? Use to separate error, negligence and misconduct.
Goleman · Salovey & Mayer Five competencies (self-awareness, selfregulation, motivation, empathy, social skill) against the four-branch ability model. Use for emotional intelligence.
Maslach · Hochschild Burnout triad — exhaustion, depersonalisation, reduced accomplishment — and emotional labour. Use for empathy fatigue.
Edmondson Psychologicalsafety—whetherbadnewstravelsupwardintime to act on. Converts EI into an organisational property.
Schein Artefacts, espoused values, basic assumptions — the three levels of organisational culture, of which the third governs.
Freeman / Friedman Stakeholder theory against the shareholder view. Use for corporate governance and for private-sector dilemmas.
Nolan Seven principles of public life — selflessness, integrity, objectivity, accountability, openness, honesty, leadership (1995). The one Western code the paper expects by name.
Finer / Friedrich External enforceable control against inner professional responsibility. The standard pairing for accountability questions.
Thaler&Sunstein Libertarianpaternalism;thenudge,whoseowntestisthat it must be cheap to avoid.
Ambedkar ‘Democracy is not merely a form of Government. It is primarily a mode of associated living.’ Form is not substance; democracy lives where people meet as equals.
Ambedkar ‘Constitutional morality is not a natural sentiment. It has to be cultivated.’ The forms are a top-dressing on an undemocratic soil.
Ambedkar ‘Howevergooda Constitutionmaybe,ifthosewhoareimplementing it are not good, it will prove to be bad.’ Institutions are only as good as the discretion exercised inside them.
Ambedkar ‘Political democracy cannot last unless there lies at the base of it social democracy.’ Equality at the ballot cannot survive inequality at the well.
